---
title: "RCP Annualized Visualization"
output: pdf_document
params:
  save_plots: true
  start_year: 2031
  start_index: 11
  dpi: 1000
---

## Setup
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

packages <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "patchwork")
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_len(8)) {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(path, "Code")) && dir.exists(file.path(path, "Data"))) return(path)
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) break
    path <- parent
  }
  stop("Set LC_DLNM_BASE_DIR to the project root.")
}
base_dir <- Sys.getenv("LC_DLNM_BASE_DIR")
if (!nzchar(base_dir)) base_dir <- find_project_root()
invisible(lapply(list.files(file.path(base_dir, "Code/Function"),
                            pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE), source))

annualized_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Results/Simulated_annualized_mortality_rates")
figure_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Figures/RCP_Simulation/Overall_annualized")

age_labels <- c(
  Y20_64 = "20-64",
  Y65_74 = "65-74",
  Y75_84 = "75-84",
  Y_GE85 = "85+"
)

scenario_labels <- c(
  rcp26 = "RCP 2.6",
  rcp85 = "RCP 8.5"
)

scenario_colors <- c(
  "RCP 2.6" = "#007bbd",
  "RCP 8.5" = "#B7282E"
)
```

## Load Annualized Simulation Results
```{r}
annualized_results <- list(
  LC = setNames(
    lapply(names(scenario_labels), function(scenario) {
      load_rcp_simulation("LC", scenario, annualized_dir, annualized = TRUE)
    }),
    scenario_labels
  ),
  LL = setNames(
    lapply(names(scenario_labels), function(scenario) {
      load_rcp_simulation("LL", scenario, annualized_dir, annualized = TRUE)
    }),
    scenario_labels
  )
)
```

## Plot Settings
```{r}
model_configs <- list(
  LC = list(
    output_dir = file.path(figure_dir, "DLNM_LC"),
    filenames = c(
      Athens = "Athens_all_scenarios_annualized_line.pdf",
      Lisbon = "Lisbon_all_scenarios_annualized_line.pdf",
      Rome = "Rome_all_scenarios_annualized_line.pdf"
    ),
    ncol = 2,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    x_limits = c(params$start_year, 2046),
    x_breaks = c(2031, 2036, 2041, 2046),
    y_expand = expansion(mult = c(0.4, 0.4)),
    major_y_grid = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    mean_size = 0.4,
    interval_size = 0.3,
    subtitle_size = 14,
    legend_text_size = 10
  ),
  LL = list(
    output_dir = file.path(figure_dir, "DLNM_LL"),
    filenames = c(
      Athens = "Athens_annualized_sim.pdf",
      Lisbon = "Lisbon_annualized_sim.pdf",
      Rome = "Rome_annualized_sim.pdf"
    ),
    ncol = 2,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    x_limits = c(params$start_year, 2046),
    x_breaks = c(2031, 2036, 2041, 2046),
    y_expand = expansion(mult = c(0.4, 0.4)),
    major_y_grid = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    mean_size = 0.4,
    interval_size = 0.3,
    subtitle_size = 14,
    legend_text_size = 10
  )
)
```

## DLNM-LC Annualized Visualisation
```{r}
LC_annualized_plots <- setNames(lapply(rcp_output_region_names, function(region) {
  plot_rcp_region_model(
    datasets = annualized_results$LC,
    region = region,
    config = model_configs$LC,
    start_index = params$start_index,
    start_year = params$start_year,
    age_labels = age_labels,
    scenario_colors = scenario_colors,
    annualized = TRUE,
    save_plots = params$save_plots,
    dpi = params$dpi
  )
}), rcp_output_region_names)

LC_annualized_plots
```
